description: This file defines the EngineState class, which manages the parsing and handling of engine-related responses for a automotive control system. It registers key-value actions, processes data responses, and maintains engine state data with callback mechanisms.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Manages engine response processing, key-value actions registration, and engine state data updates.

classes.name: EngineState.EngineStateListener
classes.description: Interface for callback to handle engine state changes, such as processing response lines.

classes.name: EngineState.EngineStateListenerImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of EngineStateListener with empty methods.

classes.name: EngineState.ValueCallback
classes.description: Generic callback interface for value updates.

classes.name: EngineState.StringActionPair
classes.description: Internal class pairing a string key with its associated callback, including a prefix used in response parsing.

methods.name: replaceStringValueAction
methods.description: Replace the callback associated with a key by removing the old one and registering a new callback.

methods.name: packString
methods.description: Wraps a string into a formatted packet with length prefix.

methods.name: unpackString
methods.description: Extracts the string content from a formatted packet, validating expected length and format.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response string, updating callbacks and engine state accordingly.

methods.name: handleStringActionPair
methods.description: Processes a response line for a specific key-value pair and updates the associated callback.

methods.name: startWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a line starts with a prefix, ignoring case, for performance optimization.

methods.name: registerStringValueAction
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific key.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Removes the callback associated with a key.

methods.name: processNewData
methods.description: Appends new data to the buffer for processing.
